craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Look-look doubled command per UNC (paśyata); gut-holding-as-if appears. Rejected: (a) single look → killed: doubled commands. Read aloud: LOOK, LOOK — HOS-tile-NOO-ses … AP-pear TO-us.

lines: Look, look — hostile nooses — those, these, outcast ever;
gut-holding as it were, speaking — appear to us.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi

reads_against.argmap: What expelled shall we see? → Doubled seeing commands; entrail-as-if appears to us.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
